messages:
Marta: Hey team — quick sync on APAC Summit joint panel + booth with NorthStar. Need to lock speakers, demo hardware, and swag shipping deadlines. Can we run through items?
Owen: I have booth floor plan, will post in this thread by EOD. Are we doing the 30-min panel + 2 demos on-stage?
Marta: Yes 30-min panel at 11am day 2, then a 20-min hands-on demo slot. On-stage demo = Redwood hosted model, SI partner shows integration.
Nadia: Speakers: Ilya (product), Priya (solutions) for Redwood. NorthStar wants to send their lead architect (John). Can we confirm Priya availability?
Marta: @Nadia confirmed with Priya — she can do it. Please ask Priya for 3 bullet talking points by Friday.
Sree: For the hands-on demo we need a GPU box on the booth (NVIDIA A10s) + a private VPC demo for private deployment walkthrough. Who's arranging hardware?
Owen: I'll coordinate with our hardware partner rep. Tentative request: 1 A10 enclosure + network patch. Shipping deadline to venue: Mar 8 local time.
Carey: Swag list: 200 tees (mixed sizes), 500 stickers, 300 postcard 1-pagers, 50 demo invite cards with QR codes + 20 premium partner handouts. Need final art by Mar 1 for print.
Marta: Good call. Also customs forms — shipping-bot, can you confirm carrier options and whether we need ATA carnet?
shipping-bot: Carrier options available: DHL Express, FedEx Priority. Estimated transit + clearance to venue: 4–7 business days. ATA carnet recommended for equipment > $5k.
jenna: Slide ownership: Redwood product deck (Ilya) — 12 slides max. Integration slides (Nadia) — 6 slides. NorthStar will provide 8 slides. Please use shared template. Deadline for draft: Mar 3.
Nadia: I'll consolidate speaker slides into the master and do a pass on transitions. Can we schedule a run-through slot for panel + demo?
Marta: Proposed rehearsal: Mar 9 @ 9am PT (slides + runbook). Demo dry-run: Mar 10 @ 5am PT (to hit APAC hours). Thoughts?
Sree: The demo runbook needs these steps: 1) start local inference service, 2) load quantized model, 3) run sample prompt, 4) show latency dashboard. I'll put a micro runbook here:
```
# demo-run.sh
./start_inference.sh --model redwood-v1 --quantize q4_0
sleep 10
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8080/generate -d '{"prompt":"Hello demo"}' | jq .
```
Carey: I'll generate QR codes for the demo invite and registration. Also need attendee stickers for partners (VIP). Who prints VIP badges?
Owen: We can print onsite. I'll mark 30 VIP badges. Need list of VIP names by Mar 5.
Marta: Action items recap: 1) Owen: booth layout + hardware contact (due EOD). 2) Sree: finalize demo runbook + container image tag (due Mar 2). 3) Carey: finalize art for swag (due Mar 1) and QR codes (due Mar 4). 4) Nadia: collect Priya bullets and consolidate slides (due Mar 3). 5) jenna: schedule rehearsals (Mar 9 + Mar 10) and send invites. 6) shipping-bot: confirm courier and carnet requirements (ASAP).
jenna: I'll create calendar invites and a shared Google folder. Invite list will include NorthStar presenters (cc Nadia).
Nadia: One more ask — can marketing share a 30s demo clip for social promotion? Carey?
Carey: Yes, we'll shoot a 30s highlight once demo is stable. Tentative shoot: Mar 7.
Marta: Perfect. If no objections I'll confirm speakers with NorthStar today and lock rehearsal times. :thumbsup:
Owen: No objections. Go ahead.
Sree: Confirming I'll push the container image to staging registry as `redwood/demo:apac-summit-v1` by Mar 2.
shipping-bot: Note: For DHL, last pickup for guaranteed delivery by Mar 8 is Mar 3. For FedEx, it's Mar 2.
Marta: Great — thank you everyone. I'll DM John @northstar_john to confirm speaker list and share runbook. We'll reconvene after slides are in. :party-parrot:
